preheat.title: Preheat
preheat.option.dimension.description: Keeps the %s ready so portals don't pause.
preheat.status.unavailable: This version of Iris isn't supported yet, so Preheat is off. Check for an update.
preheat.status.disabled: Preheat is off because no dimension is ticked.
preheat.status.noPack: Choose a shader pack in Iris to use Preheat.
preheat.status.notReady: Shaders are prepared when the game starts.
preheat.cache.off.unsupported: Your graphics card can't save shaders, so the cache is off. Everything else still works.
preheat.cache.off.paused: The shader cache is paused because the game closed twice while loading it. Delete the cache to turn it back on.
preheat.cache.off.refused: Your graphics card turned down the saved shaders, so they'll be prepared fresh until you restart.
preheat.cache.open.description: Opens the folder where shaders are saved.
preheat.cache.open.failed.detail: The folder is shown on Preheat's screen, under Shader Cache.
preheat.cache.delete.description: Deletes the saved shaders, which are prepared again when needed.
preheat.cache.delete.title: Delete the saved shaders?
preheat.cache.delete.message: They'll be prepared again the next time they're needed, which can take a little while. Nothing else is affected.
preheat.cache.deleted.detail: They'll be prepared again when they're next needed.
preheat.cache.deleteFailed.detail: Close the game and delete the folder yourself.
preheat.cache.folder.change.description: Chooses the folder your shaders are saved in.
preheat.cache.folder.title: Where Shaders Are Saved
preheat.cache.folder.label: Folder
preheat.cache.folder.browse.unavailable: This version of Minecraft can't open a folder picker. Type the folder instead.
preheat.cache.folder.browse.failed: The folder picker didn't open. Type the folder instead.
preheat.cache.folder.notUsed: Your chosen folder can't be used right now, so the default folder is in use. %s
preheat.cache.folder.problem.invalid: That isn't a valid folder name.
preheat.cache.folder.problem.relative: Type the whole folder path, not just a folder name.
preheat.cache.folder.problem.file: That's a file, not a folder.
preheat.cache.folder.problem.unwritable: Preheat can't save to that folder. Choose one you're allowed to change, on a drive that's connected.
preheat.cache.folder.problem.moveFailed: Couldn't move the saved shaders, so nothing has changed.
preheat.cache.folder.move.title: Bring your saved shaders?
preheat.cache.folder.move.message: You have %s of saved shaders. Move them to the new folder, or start fresh and leave them where they are?
preheat.cache.folder.done: Shaders are now saved in this folder.
preheat.cache.folder.done.default: Shaders are now saved in the default folder.
preheat.cache.folder.problem.notOurs: That folder already has something called preheat-shader-cache in it that Preheat didn't make. Choose another folder.
preheat.option.moddedDimensions.descript: Keeps dimensions from mods ready after your first visit.
preheat.status.switchedOff: Preheat is switched off in its settings file.
